theme_strategy: Dual Theme (Light/Dark Mode toggle). Light mode mimics Stripe (soft shadows, off-whites, highly refined focus states). Dark mode mimics Linear (deep blacks, tinted greys, subtle glowing borders, elevated z-index over shadows).

typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 maxes at text-4xl sm:text-5xl. Use fluid scaling. Jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps. Do NOT use Inter for Headings.

rules: Use 'Tinted Grey' rule. Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always tint neutrals slightly.
High contrast text ONLY. Meet APCA contrast rules.
Always explicitly set text color on hover. Example: hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white

shadows.dark: Rely on 1px borders and z-index transitions rather than heavy shadows. Use subtle glows for accents: drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(99,102,241,0.3)]

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp inner borders. In dark mode: border-white/10. In light mode: border-slate-200.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Neumorphism (Crisp)' for cards (1px border + flat background). Use 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/60) for sticky headers and navs.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg with sharp interaction animations. Active state should scale down slightly (active:scale-95). Explicit focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2).
components.inputs: Shadcn UI heavily customized. No standard browser focus. Use subtle background colors with sharp 1px border on focus.
components.cards: Cardless or highly rectangular minimalist cards with 1px border. No floating card islands with huge drop shadows. Maximum border-radius: 12px (rounded-xl).
components.tables: Dense, highly scannable. Sticky headers. Row hover states must be visible. Avatar + Name combo for employee columns.
components.navigation: macOS style sidebar. 256px expanded, 64px collapsed. Translucent glass effect.
components.dropdowns: DO NOT use transparent backgrounds. Must have solid or highly blurred background with 1px border.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Backdrop blur for the overlay (bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm).

grids_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-column grid. Gap strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_layouts.bento_grid: For overview sections, use asymmetric spans. The Hero (col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2).
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Tailwind scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Base scale 4px. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6).
grids_layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, inputs, tabular data. Optical alignment over geometrical.

motion.animations: Micro-interactions on all interactive elements. Use Framer Motion for page transitions and complex state changes.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform duration-200 ease-out). NEVER use 'transition-all' globally.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items and dashboard cards.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible, high-contrast focus rings.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

libraries.icons: lucide-react (Default for crisp geometric styling) or @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone style for premium feel)
libraries.charts: recharts (wrapped in Shadcn UI chart components)

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js/.jsx files NOT .tsx files. Generate all React components in modern ES6+ Javascript.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions. Use Shadcn calendar, dropdown-menu, dialog, etc.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for structural bento grid layouts.
Always apply hover, active, and focus states.
Ensure dark mode toggle is functional and explicitly controls classes on the root element.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Left-align most dashboard content.
Use framer-motion heavily on dashboards for entrance stagger and page transitions.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, especially in dark mode.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Break the mold with tight typography and beautiful spacing.
NEVER use dark colors as gradients.
NEVER use transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays where text visibility could be compromised.
NEVER apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly state 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.
NEVER center align the app container (.App { text-align: center }).
NEVER use AI assistant emojis for icons.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Always use 'sonner' for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
Replace Shadcn's default 'Inter' styling with 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'Manrope' for body.
